messages:
Mia (CS): quick weekly pickup for Pioneer onboarding — sharing the p95/p99 split by route + model and streaming vs non-stream. noticed a spike on /chat non-stream p99, want quick owners and actions.

James (Infra): thanks — snapshot below (sample window: last 72h, tenant: pioneer-prod). overall usage +12% w/w, spend +9%, 5xx rate ~0.7% (slight bump). main latency notes attached.

James (Infra): ```
Route      Model           Mode         p95    p99
/chat      redwood-medium  streaming    680ms  1.10s
/chat      redwood-medium  non-stream   1.20s  2.80s
/generate  gpt-mini        streaming    420ms  800ms
/generate  gpt-mini        non-stream   650ms  1.40s
/embeds    embed-x         sync         90ms   150ms
```

James (Infra): root cause hypothesis: high fraction of long prompts (avg ~1.2k tokens) -> KV cache cold and larger per-token work in non-stream path; also a handful of large back-to-back sync requests hitting the same worker causing queuing. CS Bot raised a p99 tail alert yesterday at 03:12 UTC :eyes:.

Alex (Platform): confirmed queuing on a dedicated pool inspector — seen sustained bursts that exceed our default max_batch_ms. streaming path benefits from earlier first-chunk flush so p99 stays much lower.

Mia (CS): actionables? who can flip caching/batching and what is ETA?

James (Infra): I can enable prefix/KV sticky caching for pioneer-prod (config flag) and reduce max_batch_ms from 25ms -> 10ms for their pool. estimate: changes and smoke test ~6h, roll to prod after approval.

Alex (Platform): I'll add a routing override to prefer streaming redwood-medium for /chat for pioneer-prod (canary to 5% then 50%). also recommend a quantization suggestion for gpt-mini in non-prod to shave CPU.

Sophia (AE): noting spend uptick and renewal context — Pioneer renewal in 6 weeks. we should surface this trend in the renewal packet. can we estimate cost delta if they keep current mix?

James (Infra): quick cost note: non-stream p99 spikes correlate with ~15% higher per-request compute due to longer tails; rough delta ~+7-9% monthly if no mitigation.

Mia (CS): plan:
- James -> enable KV sticky caching + reduce max_batch_ms (owner: James, ETA: EOD Fri).
- Alex -> routing override to prefer streaming for /chat, start 5% canary (owner: Alex, ETA: tomorrow morning).
- Sophia -> prepare renewal health note & cost delta for customer exec deck (owner: Sophia, ETA: next Tue).
- Mia -> follow up on error rate and customer message; coordinate enablement session for their engineers (owner: Mia, ETA: next Wed).

James (Infra): will post the exact config diff to #eng-runtime once ready and include rollback commands. snippet I'll post: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/run-config -d '{"tenant":"pioneer-prod","kv_cache":true,"max_batch_ms":10}'```

Alex (Platform): ping me once canary is live, I'll watch p99 and trace spans. we'll instrument an extra trace tag for the routing decision so we can split by path.

CS Bot: Automated alert: p99 latency > 2s on /chat non-stream (triggered 2026-03-18T03:12:08Z).

Mia (CS): thanks all. i'll update the onboarding board and close the loop once James confirms the cache rollout. :thumbsup:

Sophia (AE): scheduling a quick renewal sync with Pioneer execs — copying the latency action items into the deck.

James (Infra): quick follow-up — after cache + batch changes we expect p99 on /chat non-stream to drop towards ~1.1-1.4s (best case). will report back in this thread after canary.

Mia (CS): perfect — marking this thread as the authoritative health update for Pioneer this week.
